next.reason: 1985: "must be immediately preceded by a space or left parenthesis; ... space, comma, semicolon, period, or right parenthesis"; 2023: "preceded by a space, left parenthesis, or opening pseudo-text delimiter ... right parenthesis, or closing pseudo-text delimiter". 2023 also lets literal delimiters directly adjoin pseudo-text delimiters (e.g. =='A'==), which 1985 refused. It also allows apostrophes and prefixed delimiters (B", X", N" etc.).
